wafProbeResult: Cloudflare in front of all responses (cf-ray on every batch). 8/8 batches return 200 for normal paths; rapid burst of 10 requests over ~13s all 200; XSS-shaped query (containing literal <script>) returns 403 17925-byte challenge page = Cloudflare managed rules rule-selective on payload only; honeypot paths (xmlrpc/.env/.git/phpinfo) return canned 1483-byte 403 from origin (NOT WAF body markers — small uniform size). No MalCare/Wordfence/Sucuri/Incapsula markers in any response body. Verdict: Cloudflare passive — does not block normal crawler traffic, so hasWaf=false (per operational rule). Set hasWaf=true defensively if a production crawl from a different IP hits challenges.

wafProbeEvidence.interpretation: Cloudflare-passive + Cloudflare WAF rule-selective on XSS payload. Normal crawler traffic unaffected.

watermark.reason: WC Store API /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products honors ?after= filter. Two-probe verified: ?after=2099-01-01 returns x-wp-total: 0; ?after=1999-01-01 returns x-wp-total: 4493 (= global count). Same filter is honored on the admin /wp-json/wp/v2/product endpoint (future=0, past=11370 including drafts). HTML ?orderby=date also verified honored (default p1 first ID 210414, orderby=date first ID 263938, orderby=price first ID 243626, all different), so navigate-from-watermark is a viable fallback if API ever changes.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of 15 firearm-relevant top-level categories = 4603; /shop/ result-count = 4493 (=WC Store API x-wp-total). Overlap ~110 (2.4%) from products tagged in multiple categories. Excluded from list: 'brand' (4433, parallel aggregator covering all branded products - would double-count everything), 'uncategorized' (425, catch-all bucket including non-firearm-relevant items), and 8 typo-duplicate slugs ('4027-accessoires', 'tbsarrows-componets', '4021-ammuntion', etc., each count<=115). Chose /shop/ as the single catalogUrls entry because it returns 'Showing 1-40 of 4493 results' = guaranteed 100% coverage with one start URL; per-category list documented here for operator reference and as fallback if /shop/ ever drops out.

stageNotes: Stage 1 (Canonical URL): apex shooterschoice.com returns 200 cleanly; www.shooterschoice.com 301s to apex (location: https://shooterschoice.com/). canonicalOrigin = https://shooterschoice.com. No <link rel='canonical'> override needed.

Stage 2 (WAF + CAPTCHA): 8-batch heavy probe. Cloudflare in front (cf-ray on all batches, server: cloudflare). Rapid burst of 10 requests all 200, no rate-limit. XSS-shaped query containing <script>alert(1)</script> returns 403 17925-byte challenge body - Cloudflare WAF rule-selective on XSS payload only. SQLi-shaped queries return 200. Honeypot paths (.env, .git/config, xmlrpc.php) return canned 1483-byte 403 (uniform size = origin-level filter, not Cloudflare challenge body). phpinfo.php returned 404. wp-admin/wp-login returned 200. No MalCare/Wordfence/Sucuri/Incapsula body markers in any batch. Verdict: Cloudflare-passive (cf-ray present + all normal traffic 200); hasWaf set to false per operational rule. Cloudflare's XSS rule fires only on payloads - does NOT affect catalog crawl. CAPTCHA: reCAPTCHA v3 site-key 6Ldror4ZAAAAACSRjA1i_G8G8Ocp84Y9jrJOnrh6 loaded via Contact Form 7 on every page. Doesn't gate the crawl path (catalog pages and Store API return 200 without challenge); hasCaptcha=false operationally, captchaType=recaptcha-v3 informationally.

Stage 3 (Platform): WooCommerce 10.7.0 confirmed - wp-content/plugins/woocommerce assets, wc-blocks-style?ver=wc-10.7.0, woocommerce-loop-product CSS classes on category page, body class woocommerce woocommerce-page tax-product_cat. Theme: kingler-theme (Mistake 39: theme != platform; platform stays woocommerce). No age-gate detected - pop-up on homepage is a Mailchimp email signup (pum-overlay-disabled, click_open trigger), not age verification. WC has dedicated adapter so adapterType=woocommerce (not generic-retail). Maintain verifyMethod=store-api (WC default per Stage 3 derived-rules table).

Stage 4 (Catalog URLs): /shop/ root archive returns 'Showing 1-40 of 4493 results' on page 1 - matches WC Store API x-wp-total exactly. Single URL covers 100% of products with the smallest possible URL count. Documented 15 firearm-relevant top-level categories (sum=4603, ~2.4% cross-category overlap) in topLevelCategories.categories[] for operator reference. taxonomy API /wp-json/wp/v2/product_cat returned 1910 categories across 20 pages - many leaf and typo-duplicate slugs (4030-otpics, 4021-ammuntion, tbsarrows-componets etc., all with count=0). Excluded the 'brand' aggregator (count=4433, would double everything) and 'uncategorized' (425 catch-all).

Stage 5 (Pagination): /page/{N}/ path form works. page 1 first 5 IDs [210414, 84018, 65609, 145943, 65620] vs page 2 first 5 IDs [256134, 256135, 256138, 256140, 256141] - zero overlap. ?count=N query param IGNORED (returns 40 anyway). perPage=40 hardcoded by theme on HTML; WC Store API max perPage=100. paginationPattern.perPage=40 (HTML walk).

Stage 6 (Sort): <select name='orderby' class='orderby'> with options menu_order (default) | popularity | rating | date | price | price-desc. 3-outcome counter-control with cache-bust (_=<rand>): default p1 first ID=210414, ?orderby=date first ID=263938, ?orderby=price first ID=243626 - all three different => sort honored. ID 263938 > 256134 (p2 first) > 210414 - descending product ID = newest-first. sortParam='?orderby=date', sortVerified=true.

Stage 7 (Watermark method): api-date-since-watermark. Two-probe on /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?after=<date>: future=2099-01-01 -> x-wp-total=0, past=1999-01-01 -> x-wp-total=4493 (=global). Same probe on /wp-json/wp/v2/product: future=0, past=11370 (admin endpoint includes drafts/private). Filter honored on both. WC adapter uses Store API at runtime.

Stage 8 (Product count): wp-rest-header on /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=1 -> x-wp-total=4493. Cross-checked: /shop/ HTML result-count says '1-40 of 4493 results'. Same value. expectedProductCount=4493.
Stage 9 (Assembly): validator clean; profile written to docs/site-audit/.
